title: How Heroic Are You in the Marvel Universe?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover how heroic you are in the Marvel universe!

questions.text: When a new threat emerges, you first...

options.text: Assess the immediate danger and resources
Gather allies to discuss the situation
Imagine long-term consequences and patterns
Reflect alone on possible approaches

questions.text: When making a critical decision, you focus on...

options.text: Adapting to sudden changes
How it affects the people involved
Following a structured plan
Logical outcomes and fairness

questions.text: In your free time, you prefer to...

options.text: Spend time on personal hobbies quietly
Explore new ideas or creative pursuits
Organize a group activity with friends
Complete practical tasks or projects

questions.text: When a teammate disagrees with you, you...

options.text: Present logical arguments to persuade them
Try to understand their feelings first
Seek a compromise that works in the moment
Refer back to the team’s agreed goals

questions.text: When learning a new ability, you...

options.text: Follow step-by-step instructions carefully
Ask others to demonstrate and explain
Practice alone until you master it
Experiment with different techniques
Clear objectives and timelines
Protecting vulnerable communities
Unexpected twists and flexibility
Solving complex puzzles or challenges

questions.text: At a superhero conference, you’re drawn to...

options.text: Visionary speeches about the future
Networking with other heroes
Listening to talks rather than speaking
Practical workshops on tools and skills

questions.text: When a mission doesn’t go as planned, you...

options.text: Analyze what went wrong logically
Check on the emotional well-being of teammates
Improvise a new strategy on the spot
Stick to the backup plan you prepared

questions.text: Your hero identity is most influenced by...

options.text: The connections you have with others
Real-world experiences and lessons
Your personal values and inner strength
Dreams and aspirations for the future

questions.text: When setting priorities, you prioritize tasks that...

options.text: Allow for spontaneity and discovery
Help others feel supported
Align with your long-term goals
Achieve the most efficient outcome

questions.text: In a crisis, you communicate by...

options.text: Whispering key instructions to trusted allies
Painting a vision of how to overcome it
Shouting encouragement to rally the team
Sharing concrete details and next steps

questions.text: You believe heroism is defined by...

options.text: Rationality and integrity in choices
Empathy and compassion for others
Adaptability and openness to change
Commitment to duty and responsibility

results.title: The Compassionate Guardian
results.description: You’re driven by empathy, always putting others’ needs first. Like Captain America, you lead with heart, standing up for the vulnerable and fostering unity. Your heroism lies in your ability to connect deeply and inspire hope through kindness.

results.title: The Strategic Visionary
results.description: You thrive on big ideas and long-term planning. Like Iron Man, you combine innovation with logic, seeing possibilities others miss. Your heroism comes from turning vision into action, even when the path is unclear.

results.title: The Steadfast Protector
results.description: Dependable and grounded, you excel at practical solutions. Like Black Widow, you focus on the task at hand, using experience and precision to keep others safe. Your heroism is in your consistency and unwavering commitment.

results.title: The Creative Idealist
results.description: Imaginative and values-driven, you see the world through a lens of possibility. Like Scarlet Witch, you channel creativity and passion into fighting for what’s right, even when faced with doubt.

results.title: The Dynamic Leader
results.description: Outgoing and decisive, you rally others with energy and purpose. Like Thor, you embrace action, leading with confidence and inspiring those around you to rise to the occasion.

results.title: The Analytical Problem-Solver
results.description: Logical and detail-oriented, you thrive on solving complex challenges. Like Bruce Banner, you balance intellect with restraint, using knowledge to defuse threats and find innovative solutions.

results.title: The Warm Collaborator
results.description: Friendly and cooperative, you build strong teams through connection. Like Hawkeye, you’re the glue that holds groups together, using your social skills to ensure everyone works in harmony.

results.title: The Independent Explorer
results.description: Curious and self-reliant, you seek knowledge and new experiences. Like Doctor Strange, you embrace the unknown, trusting your intuition to guide you through uncharted territory.

results.title: The Energetic Catalyst
results.description: Spontaneous and enthusiastic, you bring momentum to any mission. Like Spider-Man, you thrive in the moment, using quick thinking and adaptability to turn chaos into opportunity.

results.title: The Principled Strategist
results.description: Organized and ethical, you plan with purpose and integrity. Like Captain Marvel, you stand firm in your values, using structure and logic to protect what matters most.

results.title: The Intuitive Healer
results.description: Compassionate and insightful, you understand others’ emotions deeply. Like Vision, you bridge divides with empathy, using your intuition to heal and unite rather than fight.

results.title: The Practical Innovator
results.description: Hands-on and resourceful, you turn ideas into tangible results. Like Shuri, you excel at problem-solving, using practical skills and creativity to build solutions that make a difference.

results.title: The Dreamy Optimist
results.description: Idealistic and imaginative, you believe in a better future. Like Star-Lord, you blend creativity with hope, seeing the good in people and inspiring others to reach for more.

results.title: The Calm Diplomat
results.description: Patient and thoughtful, you navigate conflict with grace. Like Black Panther, you listen deeply, weighing perspectives to find balanced, fair solutions that honor all involved.

results.title: The Bold Experimenter
results.description: Adventurous and open-minded, you embrace change and new ideas. Like Rocket Raccoon, you thrive on innovation, using your quick wit and adaptability to tackle even the messiest problems.

results.title: The Quiet Strength
results.description: Reserved and resilient, you let your actions speak louder than words. Like Gamora, you draw strength from within, facing challenges with quiet determination and unwavering resolve.
